scope: Read-only primary-source candidate audit for text-generative LoRA SFT data-poisoning defense; no execution, model download or repository modification.
selection_rule: Select by threat model, deployment endpoint, information access and total cost; do not exclude a method solely because its mechanism differs.

methods.name: GraCeFul
methods.stage: pre-training dataset filtering then one fine-tune
methods.information: untrusted input-output training pairs; base model and per-sample lm_head gradients; minority poison-cluster assumption; no supplied clean set or trigger
methods.algorithm: 2D DCT, retain low-frequency 1/64, PCA32, hierarchical clustering, discard smaller cluster
methods.cost: dataset-wide forward/backward, feature storage/PCA/clustering, then ordinary fine-tune; do not charge a prior full poisoned training run to native GraCeFul
methods.local_status: existing endpoint random-projection + 2-means variant is not native GraCeFul

methods.name: GradSentry
methods.stage: pre-training dataset filtering then one fine-tune
methods.native_task: generative QA, LoRA and full fine-tuning
methods.information: untrusted input-output pairs; base-model lm_head gradients; no clean labels, supplied clean set or trigger; entropy/KDE separation assumptions
methods.algorithm: subsample top 1/8 rows and columns, truncated SVD rank16, normalized singular-value entropy, KDE valley threshold with fallback0.7
methods.cost: per-sample forward/backward and truncated SVD, then fine-tune
methods.local_status: local base-model census exists; not a completed native real-data defense-and-training comparison
methods.priority: core exact-task candidate; new paper is not independent proof of universal SOTA

methods.name: DeCE
methods.native_task: code generation/repair; larger6-7B models use full-parameter BAdam rather than LoRA
methods.information: ordinary poisoned training pairs, no supplied clean set or trigger
methods.cost: one training course with modified per-token loss; zero extra model forward is not zero total overhead
methods.local_status: adapted loss exists; one-epoch decay compression is adaptation, not original recipe
methods.priority: core low-cost baseline, recipe audit before scientific failure claim

methods.name: CUBE
methods.stage: representation-learning on poisoned data, clustering/filtering, retraining
methods.native_task: original BERT classification; public generative adaptation provided by GraCeFul authors
methods.information: original observed class labels and minority poison assumption; no supplied clean set or trigger
methods.algorithm: original UMAP10D + HDBSCAN, keep largest predicted clusters per observed class
methods.cost: representation-training course plus feature extraction/clustering plus clean-subset training
methods.local_status: planned; spectral-signature/2-means/activation-clustering proxies do not establish native CUBE performance
methods.priority: representative strong different-mechanism comparator; select public generative adaptation

methods.name: MuScleLoRA
methods.native_task: original Llama2/GPT2XL experiments are SST-2 classification; public generative FSQA adaptation exists
methods.information: clean auxiliary data:128 examples for LLMs from validation; clean auxiliary gradient every update; no known trigger
methods.cost: modified multi-scale LoRA and extra clean-gradient computation, changes adapter parameterization
methods.local_status: planned only per local baseline inventory
methods.priority: extra-clean-data track if that deployment resource is allowed

methods.name: RFTC
methods.stage: pre-training reference filtration and response TF-IDF clustering
methods.native_task: machine translation and CoQA generation; LoRA not specified in checked main method/setup
methods.information: external task-capable reference model not compromised by the same attack; no supplied clean subset or known trigger
methods.cost: reference model inference/generation for dataset then CPU TF-IDF/KMeans and ordinary training
methods.priority: optional external-reference-model track; relevant despite different mechanism

methods.name: CROW
methods.native_task: generative LLM sentiment steering/refusal/code injection; LoRA repair
methods.information: 100 clean Alpaca examples, no clean reference model or trigger knowledge
methods.cost: additional5-epoch LoRA repair with adversarial perturbations and consistency regularization; include all repair passes
methods.local_status: short-pulse proposal paused/unrun; retained as endpoint-repair candidate
methods.priority: minimum post-training strong-method track if final deployed safety/quality is claimed; do not exclude by mechanism

methods.name: Honeypot
methods.stage: training-time auxiliary shallow branch plus main-network weighting
methods.native_task: BERT/RoBERTa classification, not native generative LoRA
methods.information: poisoned training data; no holdout clean subset or known trigger needed by method
methods.cost: additional transformer/classifier branch and an epoch of honeypot warmup
methods.code_status: author method code not verified in checked paper/repository searches; paper's OpenBackdoor link concerns baseline implementation
methods.priority: related-work/mechanism comparator unless a faithful generative adaptation is specified

methods.name: BYORn
methods.native_task: VLM autoregressive LoRA SFT; text-only transfer unverified
methods.information: pretrained VLM response-likelihood scoring; EMA model-generated replacements; no known trigger
methods.cost: initial dataset scoring and autoregressive generation on flagged samples; EMA state
methods.local_status: full BYORn unimplemented; static base-loss prefilter only resembles BYORn-F
methods.priority: VLM expansion or explicitly labeled text adaptation, not a native current-task result

minimum_set_proposal: existing A0/A1 controls and strongest fixed-warmup LT
native GraCeFul + native GradSentry to repair present closest-task evidence gaps
one representative generative CUBE comparison if independent representation family is needed
CROW only in clearly labeled clean-data endpoint track; MuScleLoRA and RFTC alternatives depend on allowed auxiliary resources
not_executed: All priorities are discussion-only; no new experiment is authorized or launched.
